1164-2173-3114-4740.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or higher.
1164-2173-3114-4740.description:
Cast Yawgmoth's Will by paying {2}{B}
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Yawgmoth's Will, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Bolas's Citadel
Repeat from step 2.
1164-2173-3114-4740.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

1339-1531-1832-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1531-1832-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-2577-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2034-2577-5478-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2034-2577-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2595-4247--5.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4247--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing your creatures that enter this turn to enter with a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2

567-1981-2415-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

553-1542-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Wizards of Thay.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-7315.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to High Score
Repeat.

443-1263-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1494-3365-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Aeromoeba by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2103-2493-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7-457-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
7-457-1792-4404.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-457-1792-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Hamza.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4359-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4559-4659-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
4559-4659-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4659-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

454-1978-7066.description:
Cause The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat

2796-5639.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
2796-5639.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve Arm-Mounted Anchor's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Repeat.

3634-3821-6751.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax minus {1} if applicable.
3634-3821-6751.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Venser either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Venser enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-3197-4499-4929-6457.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional nonland permanent.
2060-3197-4499-4929-6457.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

5090-6266.easyPrerequisites:
Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
Singing Bell Strike attached to Redshift.
5090-6266.notablePrerequisites: Redshift, Rocketeer Chief has power 7 or greater.
5090-6266.description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding at least seven mana of any color that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Redshift.
Repeat.

3204-4068-4251-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least one Mountain.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4068-4251-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

522-4179-5064.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Goblins.
522-4179-5064.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five Goblins you control, putting ten -1/-1 counters on each creature opponents control and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

1558-1822-2334-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere's first ability and Soulherder's first ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Soulherder triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve both Myr Battlesphere triggers, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1712-2060-5003-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jugan.
Jugan dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Jugan trigger, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Jugan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

29-178-430.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature with power one or greater for each opponent you have.
The additional creatures can attack this turn.
Opponents are unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You have not created a token this turn.
29-178-430.description:
Declare the additional creatures as attackers, ensuring each creature is attacking a different opponent.
Adeline triggers, creating a token copy of Master of Cruelties due to Esix that is tapped and attacking each opponent.
When each Master of Cruelties is not blocked, they trigger, setting each opponent life total to one.
Deal combat damage with the additional creatures, causing each opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

2239-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Ardent Elementalist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding {B}.
Ardent Elementalist triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
